title: Wiki Page Provenance
description: Machine projection of a wiki page's frontmatter and managed-block state (specification.md section 4). Produced by the wiki reader, consumed by validate, freshness and the MCP wiki resource. Not a file on disk of its own.

verifiedAt.description: Git sha the page was last verified against. Null means never verified, which is NOT the same as fresh.

describes.description: Resolved describe-set for this page. Empty is legal (an architecture page may describe no single path) but makes the page undecidable for freshness.

origin.description: Precedence, highest first: frontmatter beats related-code beats key-files (specification.md section 3.2).

managedBlock.description: State of the keryx:reference managed region.

recordedHash.description: sha256 recorded in the opening marker at the last machine write.

handEdited.description: True when recordedHash and currentHash differ: someone edited inside the machine region. `wiki refresh` must refuse without --force.

humanAnchors.description: Count of keryx:human anchored regions that automation must reproduce byte-identically.

isDraftPlaceholder.description: True while the section still holds the generated `_Draft - ..._` placeholder.
